Wash and Care Instructions
  • Wash in Cold Water Only - Max temperature 85F / 30C
  • Wash shirts inside-out for best results
  • Tumble dry low or hang-dry to avoid as much shrinking as possible
  • Do not dry clean
  • Do not bleach
